style_context: Household pet care, animal housing, pet training, and safe preparation for pet activities

images.description: Clean educational weekly pet care log page on a clipboard with clearly separated rows for feeding, water, habitat cleaning, exercise, and health checks across seven days, a few boxes filled with short realistic entries and check marks, visual emphasis on repeated routine patterns, minimal horizontal labels only, no branding
images.value: A filled weekly log layout shows how evidence of steady pet care should be organized over time, which is much clearer visually than prose alone

images.description: Four-panel educational comparison grid showing a dog resting area, a bird cage setup, a filtered aquarium, and a reptile terrarium, each panel highlighting one or two key housing features such as space, perch variety, filtration, basking light, clean bedding, and enrichment, very short horizontal labels only, no branding
images.value: Side-by-side housing examples reveal how different species need different environments and equipment in ways a text list cannot visualize as quickly

images.description: Top-down organized pet show prep kit on a plain table with a carrier, collapsible water bowl, brush, towel, cleanup bags, treats, leash, and paperwork folder, each item separated cleanly with short horizontal labels, simple educational layout, no branding
images.value: A labeled gear layout lets the reader instantly see what belongs in a pet-show prep kit and how the supplies fit together

images.description: Four-panel instructional sequence of a pet dog learning roll over through shaping, showing panel 1 down position, panel 2 head turn toward a treat, panel 3 shoulder roll, and panel 4 full roll over with reward, simple arrows between panels, very short horizontal labels only, no branding
images.value: Step-by-step progression makes shaping visible by showing how a finished trick is built from small rewarded actions, something text alone struggles to convey
